title: What Digital Ownership Registries 2.0 Is
definition: Digital Ownership Registries 2.0: next-gen registries for digital art.
description:
Digital Ownership Registries 2.0: next-gen registries for digital art. This is Future Art, Design & Fashion at its most ambitious — provenance chains research, registry logistics engineering and artist royalties operations converging on a single goal: making registry hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Art, Design & Fashion will decide dispute resolution outcomes this century. Digital Ownership Registries 2.0 is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working registry hulls, the larger provenance chains vision stalls, and with it, the registry logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Digital Ownership Registries 2.0 in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Digital Ownership Registries 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Digital Ownership Registries 2.0.
description:
The road to Digital Ownership Registries 2.0 is already being paved. TeamLab's immersive museums draw millions to digital-native art experiences. The Fashion for Good museum and Global Fashion Agenda push circular fashion.

Digital fashion (DressX, The Fabricant) sells clothes that exist only on avatars. Together these programs form the provenance chains foundation that Digital Ownership Registries 2.0 will build on — the registry logistics results, the artist royalties methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as registry logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Digital Ownership Registries 2.0
definition: Estimates Digital Ownership Registries 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Digital Ownership Registries 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a registry hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Digital Ownership Registries 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Digital Ownership Registries 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Digital Ownership Registries 2.0 — next-gen registries for digital art.

Phase 1 — Prove (provenance chains): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (registry logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (artist royalties): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (dispute resolution): registry hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and collectors-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
